title: Moriya-Renormalized Analytical Ladder Dual-Fermion Framework for the Three-Dimensional Hubbard Model Near the Mott Transition: Unified Levels III-IV Edition
description:
Closed, UV-finite, non-singular, and fully deterministic O(N log N) QMC-free diagrammatic extension of single-site Dynamical Mean-Field Theory (DMFT) for the three-dimensional (3D) repulsive Hubbard and multi-orbital Kanamori models at finite temperature and small hole doping (δ = 1 − n). This release bundles the Unified Levels III–IV manuscript (MR-ALDF-III/IV) together with the complete Python implementation, benchmark data, and validation figures.

  • Level III Core (mr_aldf_level3.py): Exact fourth-spectral-moment interpolating perturbation theory (mIPT-4) with correlated kinetic band shift, UV-tail-regularized rank-2 Ward-constrained local charge vertices detecting irreducible charge-vertex divergence lines, non-singular dual-denominator Moriya spin regularization via the Pauli sum rule, three-channel (s + c + pp) dual ladders with 3D Oh Eg (d-wave) pairing diagnostics, and Maki-Thompson dual current vertex corrections.
  • Level IV Core (mr_aldf_level4.py): Smooth C∞ dual-inverse Herglotz causality control, parameter-free microscopic 3D O(3) bosonic Self-Consistent Screening Approximation (SCSA), self-consistent TU-SBE Eg pairing feedback, 2×2 C-parity-obeying Aslamazov-Larkin optical drag, and 50-digit Schur/Nevanlinna analytic continuation.
  • Five Level-IV Production Pillars: (1) Sparse odd-symmetric Discrete Lehmann Representation (DLR) engine (mr_aldf_dlr.py, mr_aldf_level4_dlr.py) reaching T = 0.02t and L = 12 (N = 1728 sites); (2) explicit 2×2 sublattice Néel AFM and Nambu Eg (d-wave) ordered-phase solvers (mr_aldf_neel.py, mr_aldf_nambu_sc.py); (3) Track IV-B symmetry-sector Lehmann exact diagonalization with Rank-6 SVD local vertices and multi-line charge-vertex divergence detection (mr_aldf_ed.py, mr_aldf_ed_vertex.py, mr_aldf_track4b.py); (4) deep-Mott three-particle γ(6) spin-polaron and two-magnon contractions (mr_aldf_gamma6.py); and (5) M = 1, 2, 3 multi-orbital Kanamori solvers benchmarked on V2O3 Hund's-metal, orbital-selective Mott, and RNiO3 crystal-field oxide proxies (mr_aldf_kanamori.py).
